title: Holding Entries Without the Headache
hook: Hold northwest of DONNA, right turns. Which entry? You have until the fix.

scenes.narration: You're level at eight thousand over the high desert when Approach cuts in: hold northwest of DONNA, two-seven-zero inbound, right turns, expect further in twenty. Alright kid. Let's earn that clearance.
onScreenText: "Hold NW of DONNA, 270 inbound, right turns"

scenes.narration: Before I teach you a thing — you're heading zero-nine-zero, pointed straight at DONNA. Direct, parallel, or teardrop? Commit. Out loud.

Here's the machine. Draw one line through DONNA, seventy degrees off the inbound course. Why seventy? Because it carves the sky so every arrival gets a turn the airplane can actually fly. Three sectors. Three entries.
Your heading — zero-nine-zero — lands in the big slice. That's your answer: direct. Cross DONNA, turn right, fall in line. Direct is free money, kid. Take it.
onScreenText: DIRECT: cross the fix, turn outbound

scenes.narration: Now, if you'd come at DONNA from the southwest — that's the narrow sliver. Teardrop: cut thirty degrees into the protected side, one minute, turn back. From the northwest wedge? Parallel: ride the course outbound, then turn back into the hold.
Eyes off the diagram. Name all three entries and where each one lives. Out loud — I'll wait. My coffee's not going anywhere.
Big slice, direct. Narrow sliver, teardrop. Wide wedge, parallel. And nobody's grading your geometry, kid — pick one, stay in protected airspace, and DONNA will still be there tomorrow.
Homework: A I M five dash three dash eight. It's a page-turner.

quiz.question: Holding at DONNA, 270 inbound, right turns. You arrive heading 090, pointed at the fix. Entry?
quiz.explanation: Heading 090 arrives through the ~180° 'big slice' — cross the fix and turn right outbound. (AIM 5-3-8)

quiz.question: The recommended entry sectors are divided by a line drawn at what angle to the inbound holding course?
quiz.explanation: The 70° line through the fix splits the non-direct region into the parallel and teardrop sectors.

quiz.question: In a teardrop entry, after crossing the fix you fly...
choices: ~30° off the outbound course on the holding side, then turn to intercept inbound
Parallel to the inbound course on the non-holding side
quiz.explanation: Teardrop: proceed on an outbound track ~30° to the holding side, then turn back to intercept the inbound course. (AIM 5-3-8)
